// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/automation-recommender: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const AUTOMATION_ADOPTION_PROVIDER_ID = "system.automation-adoption";

export declare const AUTOMATION_CATEGORIES: readonly ["hooks", "skills", "connections", "roles", "commands"];

export declare const AUTOMATION_HINT_KINDS: readonly ["git_host", "file", "dependency"];

export declare const AUTOMATION_OFFER_LIMIT = 3;

export declare const AUTOMATION_PROVIDER_ID = "system.automation-recommendations";

export declare const AUTOMATION_QUIET_REASONS: readonly ["off", "recent", "no-workspace", "nothing-new", "no-assistant"];

export interface AutomationAdoptInput {
    readonly adopt: readonly string[];
    readonly never: readonly string[];
    readonly skill_state: Exclude<SkillState, "off">;
}

export interface AutomationAdoptResult {
    readonly adoption_id: string;
    readonly summary: string;
    readonly enabled: readonly {
        readonly id: string;
        readonly title: string;
    }[];
    readonly hidden: readonly {
        readonly id: string;
        readonly title: string;
    }[];
    readonly authorization_id?: string;
}

export type AutomationCategory = typeof AUTOMATION_CATEGORIES[number];

export interface AutomationEvidence {
    readonly workspace_id: string;
    readonly workspace: string;
    readonly path: string;
    readonly fingerprint?: string;
    readonly signals: readonly AutomationSignal[];
    readonly hints?: readonly AutomationHint[];
}

export interface AutomationGap {
    readonly code: "no-workspace" | "budget" | "unreadable" | "directory-unavailable" | "preferences-unavailable";
    readonly workspace?: string;
    readonly path?: string;
    readonly category?: AutomationCategory;
}

export interface AutomationHint {
    readonly service_id: string;
    readonly kind: AutomationHintKind;
    readonly hint: string;
}

export type AutomationHintKind = (typeof AUTOMATION_HINT_KINDS)[number];

export type AutomationNext = {
    readonly kind: "skill";
    readonly ref: SkillRef;
} | {
    readonly kind: "connection";
    readonly service_id: string;
} | {
    readonly kind: "role";
    readonly owner_id: string;
    readonly role_id: string;
    readonly install_id: string;
    readonly plugin_version: string;
};

export type AutomationOfferResult = {
    readonly offered: true;
    readonly work_id: string;
    readonly count: number;
} | {
    readonly offered: false;
    readonly reason: AutomationQuietReason;
};

export interface AutomationOffersSetting {
    readonly enabled: boolean;
}

export interface AutomationPreference {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly choice: AutomationPreferenceChoice;
}

export type AutomationPreferenceChoice = "ignored" | "already-have" | "hidden";

export interface AutomationPreferenceInput {
    readonly save_token: string;
    readonly expected_revision: string;
    readonly suggestion_id: string;
    readonly choice: AutomationPreferenceChoice | "show";
}

export interface AutomationPreferences {
    readonly revision: string;
    readonly choices: readonly AutomationPreference[];
}

export type AutomationQuietReason = (typeof AUTOMATION_QUIET_REASONS)[number];

export interface AutomationReport {
    readonly groups: readonly {
        category: AutomationCategory;
        suggestions: readonly AutomationSuggestion[];
    }[];
    readonly evidence: readonly AutomationEvidence[];
    readonly gaps: readonly AutomationGap[];
    readonly preferences: AutomationPreferences | null;
    readonly save_token: string;
}

export type AutomationSignal = "javascript" | "python" | "rust" | "go" | "frontend" | "tests" | "format" | "ci" | "configured";

export interface AutomationSuggestion {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly category: AutomationCategory;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly reason: string;
    readonly effect: string;
    readonly requirements: readonly string[];
    readonly risk: string;
    readonly confidence: "high" | "medium";
    readonly evidence: readonly AutomationEvidence[];
    readonly next: AutomationNext;
}

export interface AutomationUndoResult {
    readonly adoption_id: string;
    readonly summary: string;
    readonly restored: readonly string[];
    readonly kept: readonly {
        readonly title: string;
        readonly reason: string;
    }[];
}

export declare const automationAdoptionActions: {
    adopt: ActionDefinition<AutomationAdoptInput, AutomationAdoptResult>;
    undo: ActionDefinition<{
        adoption_id: string;
    }, AutomationUndoResult>;
};

export declare const automationRecommendationActions: {
    scan: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, AutomationReport>;
    preference: ActionDefinition<AutomationPreferenceInput, AutomationPreferences>;
    save: ActionDefinition<{
        save_token: string;
    }, {
        document_id: string;
    }>;
    offer: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, AutomationOfferResult>;
    offers: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, AutomationOffersSetting>;
    setOffers: ActionDefinition<AutomationOffersSetting, AutomationOffersSetting>;
};
